title: Does zeroing a vermin population entry stop that vermin appearing? This is the v5.9 Vermin panel's whole premise. Addendum 54 makes the test sharper than it was: two levers reach vermin and only one is safe — zeroing an ENTRY is the ordinary population mechanism, while zeroing a vermin's FREQUENCY is exactly what froze the game, since CREEPY_CRAWLER is a vermin and the only underground rotter. This arm zeroes entries only and never touches a frequency. A season on CTRL against an untouched control, two replicates each, tool disabled, counting live vermin objects by race.
fork: Can the tool control vermin through the entry it already manages, without going near a frequency.

predictions.expects: the zeroed arm ends with markedly fewer live vermin objects and fewer distinct races than the control

predictions.model: vermin ignore the entry, as cavern life ignores it
predictions.expects: both arms carry the same vermin; the entry is bookkeeping and the Vermin panel needs a different lever

predictions.model: vermin are seeded once at embark
predictions.expects: both arms hold whatever the map started with and neither gains new races — the same shape E20 found for water

kill_criterion: a clear drop in live vermin in the zeroed arm, 2 of 2, makes the entry the Vermin panel's lever; no difference sends the panel looking elsewhere
culling: drop a replicate on any changed save

arms.name: entries_zeroed
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local z=0; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local ty=df.world_population_type[pop.type]; if (ty=='Vermin' or ty=='VerminInnumerable' or ty=='ColonyInsect') and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, {land=true}) and pop.quantity>0 then pop.quantity=0; pop.flags.extinct=true; z=z+1 end end; print(('e27: %d vermin entries zeroed — every managed vermin ENTRY zeroed (no frequency touched)'):format(z))

local V=df.global.world.event.vermin; local by,tot={},0; for _,v in ipairs(V) do local c=df.creature_raw.find(v.race); local t=c and c.creature_id or '?'; by[t]=(by[t] or 0)+1; tot=tot+1 end; local parts={}; local ks={}; for k in pairs(by) do ks[#ks+1]=k end; table.sort(ks); for _,k in ipairs(ks) do parts[#parts+1]=k..' x'..by[k] end; local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local vq=0; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local ty=df.world_population_type[pop.type]; if (ty=='Vermin' or ty=='VerminInnumerable' or ty=='ColonyInsect') and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, {land=true}) then if pop.quantity<10000001 then vq=vq+pop.quantity end end end; local cz=0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=cz+1 end end; print(('e27: vermin_objects=%d citizens=%d countable_vermin_pool=%d day=%d | %s'):format(tot,cz,vq,math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200),table.concat(parts,', '):sub(1,200)))
